notes: Lead: CTO (J. Muller) cares about predictable latency and predictable monthly cost —
Current stack: Ruby on Rails frontend, Go backend, Postgres + vector DB for embeddings
Primary workload: product UI assistant (chat) + support deflection (embeddings/rerank)
Traffic profile: spiky daytime usage; target sustained throughput 300-500 QPS during peaks
Latency SLOs: p95 <= 250ms for chat token generation; p50 ~ 80-120ms desired
Cost sensitivity: want 20-30% unit cost reduction vs hosted baseline before committing
Model preferences: open variants OK; prefer quantized medium-latency models for most paths
POC ask (agreed): 6-week Dedicated POC — include canary rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%), metrics dashboard

Canary plan details: start at 10% traffic to dedicated pool (non-critical tenants), monitor p95, error-rate, token cost; step to 50% after 48 hours of stable metrics; full cutover after 1 week at 50% stable
Rollback criteria: any sustained p95 > 400ms for 30m OR error-rate > 1% for 15m OR token cost delta > +25% triggers immediate rollback to previous routing config

Fallback routing: primary route -> dedicated (gptx-13b-quant), fallback variant -> dedicated low-cost (gptx-7b-fast), cross-region failover -> hosted-api in us-east1 then us-west1, final fallback -> hosted_api paid tier with rate-limited responses
Model variants:
- gptx-13b-quant: default quality/latency balance
- gptx-7b-fast: lower cost, lower quality for non-critical prompt templates
- gptx-13b-pt: higher quality for billing-sensitive flows (billing queries, legal)
Routing policies: weighted by tenant criticality + route by latency budget; automatic fallback when capacity < 30%
Observability: want token-level cost breakdown, per-route p95/p50, trace IDs mapped to Fireflies meeting samples
Security notes: must integrate with company Okta SSO (SAML), KMS for key wrapping, logs forwarded to Splunk for audit
Infra notes: network team requires 2-week maintenance window for peering; estimated 4-6 hours config time
Legal: NDA in place; SOC2 attestation requested before procurement; Redwood to provide SOC2 + ISO docs
Quote from CTO on call: "We need predictable worst-case numbers, not just best-case latency."
POC success metrics (finalized): p95 <= 250ms, error rate < 0.5%, 20% token cost improvement over hosted baseline, no security exceptions
Next meeting: POC kickoff 2026-03-10 pending infra window confirmation
